A few minutes (after completing the required quests)

The Yalaharian Outfit is the reward of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}. This outfit is special: you can only have **one** of the two addons. After the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}, take the {item:Vampiric Crest} to {npc:Palimuth}: you get the Sage or the Villain addon depending on the side you chose in mission 9 of the Yalahar quest.
Addon: have completed the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest} (to obtain the {item:Vampiric Crest}).
obtained in the Blood Brothers Quest
**One** of the two addons (Sage or Villain), depending on the side chosen in mission 9
Matching achievement: **Yalahari of Wisdom** or **Yalahari of Power**

You can only have **one** of the two addons, and which one depends on the choice you make in **mission 9** of the In Service of Yalahar Quest: {npc:Palimuth}'s side gives the **Sage** addon; {npc:Yalahari (NPC)|Azerus}'s side gives the **Villain** addon. Choose carefully.
The dangers listed are from the required quests (the Yalahar quarters and Vengoth), not from handing in the addon.
Complete the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} to receive the Yalaharian Outfit. In **mission 9** you will have to choose a side — that choice decides which addon you can get.
The choice in mission 9 defines which of the two addons you will receive; you can't have both.
Complete the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}, in {wiki:Vengoth}, to obtain the {item:Vampiric Crest}.

With the {item:Vampiric Crest}, take a boat to **Yalahar**: for example, in Venore talk to {npc:Captain Fearless} at the city's north port and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (there are also boats to Yalahar in Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope and Thais). You arrive at the Yalahar harbour, next to {npc:Karith}'s boat; get off the boat onto the dock and walk **north** to the centre of the city (Inner City) of {wiki:Yalahar}, where {npc:Palimuth} is ({coord:32802,31223,7}).
With the {item:Vampiric Crest} in your inventory, go to **Yalahar**, talk to {npc:Palimuth} and say {key:hi} and {key:addon}. You receive the addon corresponding to the side you chose in mission 9.
Sage or Villain Addon + achievement Yalahari of Wisdom / Yalahari of Power

To go back, return to the harbour and board {npc:Karith}'s boat. Since you have already completed the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, he takes you to Ab'Dendriel (160 gp), Ankrahmun (230 gp), Carlin (185 gp), Darashia (210 gp), Liberty Bay (275 gp), Port Hope (260 gp), Thais (200 gp) or Venore (185 gp): say {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.
Karith, on the Yalahar harbour boat
Only one addon of this outfit is possible per character.
